test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 24 days. B and C together can do it in 36 days. If A is thrice as good a workman as C, in how many days can B alone do the work?
solution:
**Given**

A and B completes a work in 24 days

B and C completes a work in 36 days

Efficiency of A = 3 × efficiency of C

**Calculation**

Let C completes a work in x days.

so, A completes a work in (x/3) days

B completes a work in y days

One day work done by A and B 

(3/x) + (1/y) = 1/24

(1/y) + (1/x) = 1/36

let (1/x) = a and (1/y) = b

3a + b = 1/24

⇒ 72 a + 24b = 1 ---- (1)

b + a = 1/36

⇒ 36b + 36a = 1 ---- (2)

⇒ 36b = 1 - 36a

⇒ b = (1 - 36a)/36 ---- (3)

72a + 24(1 - 36a)/36 = 1 (from 1 and 3)

⇒ 72a + 2(1 - 36a)/3 = 1

⇒ 72a + (2 - 72a)/3 = 1

⇒ (216a + 2 - 72a )/3 = 1

⇒ 144a + 2 = 3

⇒ 144a = 3 -2

⇒ 144a = 1

a = 1/44

3 × (1/144) + b = 1/24 (from 1)

⇒ 1/48 + b = 1/24

⇒ b = (1/24 ) - (1/48)

⇒ b = (2 - 1)/48

⇒ b = 1/48

**∴ Number of days taken by B to complete a work is 48 days **
